about: Every frozen runtime module (README, "The runtime contract", "Only from the repository"): append-only. An entry is a module frozen, {name, version, hash, limits, users}, or a frozen module withdrawn, {"withdrawn": hash}; there are no floors. A module is loaded only by a hash listed here and not withdrawn after, and only when its bytes have that hash. `sh freeze.sh --check`, in the box, rebuilds each module and fails when its bytes aren't the frozen hash: a change to a runtime is its next version, appended.
